f-012-011-01.label: ما لك لا تأمنا

f-012-013-01.label: وليحزنني
f-012-013-01.note: 'Likewise in all' is read as the fatḥ of the yāʾ and ḍamm of the zāy given for al-Anbiyāʾ; al-Mabsūṭ states the same for Abū Jaʿfar and the rest.

f-012-013-02.label: الذئب

f-012-062-01.label: وقال لفتيانه
f-012-062-01.note: The Taḥbīr sentence names Ḥafṣ, Ḥamza and Khalaf for the alif and nūn and gives the tāʾ to the rest, so al-Kisāʾī is shown with the rest. an-Nashr (vol. 2 p. 295) and al-Mabsūṭ both name al-Kisāʾī with the alif and nūn. The entry follows the Taḥbīr sentence as printed.
